brief: Fighter 2 throws a right cross that lands on your head at 0.8 s if you stay in the guard; slip it: move the head off the line in time so the fist never comes within 5 cm of it, staying balanced with the feet planted.
notes: Fighter 2 plays the punch template's cross (templates/punch.json) facing the hero, placed so the fist meets the guard's head at 0.8 s. 30 fps.
